metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Monday, March 16, 1891, page 5.

facts.fact: Rev. William Jones, pastor of the Floating Bethel of Cincinnati, said that at 16 he had been a prize fighter backed as a boy wonder by Tom Allen of St. Louis

notes: Tags changed from Profiles to Fights: the article only mentions Allen backing a young fighter. The date of Jones's fighting is not given.
